data_parameter_evidence: pairwise exact provenance hashes, then complete legacy tuples, then auditable neutral 0.5
resource_cost_interpretation: resource_cost_score and cost_efficiency are already higher-is-better
evaluation_evidence: Requested trust/explainability dimensions require benchmark_evaluation_v1 by default (or explicitly selected production_evaluation_v1), complete status, sufficient evidence, and a finite measured score for every service. Missing group scores remain missing. Unrequested missing scores do not affect utility.
penalty: weighted mean of squared, normalized one-sided QoS-target violations
reference_interpretation: An exhaustive reference is exact only for this frozen surrogate objective and the verified candidate space.
quality_prediction: Realised-training-count weighted mean of catalogue metric_score; an uncalibrated aggregate-quality heuristic.
quality_measurement: Same named primary metric and generator metric_score_value normalisation on the reserved audit set.
latency_prediction: Mean member latency in seconds per example; one aggregate model executes.
latency_measurement: Total aggregate inference seconds divided by audit example count.
measured_utility_scope: Quality and inference latency measured; other dimensions retain catalogue evidence and are not remeasured aggregate properties.
